title: Fixing a nondeterministic choice
statement: Given an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes and a fixed choice bit $b \in \{0,1\}$, fixing that bit yields an oracle Turing machine with the same initial, query, positive-answer, and negative-answer states, whose transition function is the original transition function evaluated at $b$.
